effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] 1 of your Digimon with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and +3000 DP for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, gain 1 memory.
